name: Laura Ophio
source: A kind, sweet, and nervous florist. She has an eye for beauty but below her charm and sweetness are regret and sadness. Somewhat of an empath, she’s highly in tune with the feelings of people around her though she tries to keep it to herself. Due to an incident with her sister when they were very young she has an intense fear of snakes, but also feels somewhat guilty over her older twin’s sister’s intense need to stay honest and her stubborn personality. She is participating in The Game of Fourtune to help her ailing daughter.
